record_title: Spectral-radius ordered-product growth can oscillate under a smooth hyperbolic cocycle
provenance: A source-specific correction to the spectral-radius ordered-product convergence claim in arXiv:2609.18017v1.
limitations: The construction disproves unrestricted convergence and coordinate invariance of the spectral-radius diagnostic, but does not challenge the source paper’s reported numerical behavior for its specific Hénon and Ikeda trajectories or classify sufficient convergence hypotheses.
